en.headline: HKTDC Wine and Spirits Fair opens today at HKCEC with over 620 exhibitors
en.dek: The 18th edition runs until Saturday, with a public tasting zone open on the final day for visitors aged 18 and above.
body: The Hong Kong Trade Development Council said the 18th Hong Kong International Wine and Spirits Fair opens today at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre in Wan Chai.

More than 620 exhibitors from over 25 countries and regions are taking part, displaying wines, spirits, sake, beer and low- and no-alcohol drinks from more than 40 places of origin. The World of Spirits zone includes first-time participants from Mexico, Portugal, Slovakia and the United Kingdom, while Georgia and Italy’s Calabria region debut wine pavilions. Top Chinese baijiu brands including Kweichow Moutai are also present.

Trade visitors are admitted free with pre-registration on Thursday and Friday from 10am to 7pm. On Saturday the Saturday Fiesta public zone opens from 10am to 6pm for those aged 18 and above, with tickets at HK$220. The fair is expected to reinforce Hong Kong’s role as a wine and spirits trading hub.

zh.headline: 香港國際美酒展今日在會展開幕 逾620間參展商參與
zh.dek: 第18屆展覽至周六結束，最後一天設公眾品酒區，18歲或以上人士可入場。
body: 香港貿發局表示，第18屆香港國際美酒展今日在灣仔香港會議展覽中心開幕。
逾620間來自25個以上國家及地區的參展商參展，展示來自40多個產地的葡萄酒、烈酒、清酒、啤酒及低酒精或無酒精飲品。烈酒世界展區有來自墨西哥、葡萄牙、斯洛伐克及英國的首次參展商，格魯吉亞及意大利卡拉布里亞區則首次設立葡萄酒館。貴州茅台等十大中國白酒品牌亦有參與。
周四及周五上午10時至下午7時，預先登記的業內人士免費入場。周六「星期六嘉年華」公眾區開放，上午10時至下午6時，18歲或以上人士可持票入場，門票220港元。展覽旨在龔固香港作為美酒烈酒貿易樞紐的地位。
